images.caption:
Trikut is a holy place where ancient temple of lord ganesha lies, these ancient temple lies occupied by river godavari most of the year, for few duration in summer of northen tropical hemisphere it is visible.
The ganpati temple lies in the river at the juncture of two important rivers one of is aasana river, holy water of these juncture consecrates the shivlinga of the temple along with lord ganesha.
